chunks: Dawud al-Jassas narrated to us saying: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying
'And signs; and by the star they are guided' [16:16]
He said: 'The star is the Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah upon him and his family), and the signs — they are the Imams (peace be upon them).'

key_terms.النَّجْمُ: the star — here interpreted as the Prophet Muhammad, the supreme guide
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: the Imams — the divinely appointed successors who guide the Muslim community
key_terms.الْعَلَامَاتُ: the signs/landmarks — here interpreted as the Imams who serve as guides after the Prophet
key_terms.يَهْتَدُونَ: they are guided — spiritual guidance toward truth and salvation

ai.seo_question: What is the Shia interpretation of 'the star' and 'signs' in Quran 16:16?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) provides an esoteric interpretation of Quran 16:16, identifying 'the star' as the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and 'the signs' as the Imams. This ta'wil (inner interpretation) asserts that just as physical stars and landmarks guide travelers, the Prophet and the Imams serve as the spiritual guides of humanity. The teaching was received through Dawud al-Jassas who personally heard the Imam, situating this interpretation within the tradition of direct transmission from the Imams.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Abu Dawood Al Mustariq who said, ‘Al Dawood Al Jassas narrated to us saying, 
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying
(with regards to) [16:16] And Signs; and by the star they are being guided.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The ‘star’ is Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and the ‘signs’, they<sup>asws</sup> are the Imams<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash‘ari from MuAlia ibn Muhammad from abu Dawud al-Mustariqq who has said that Dawad al-Jassas who has said that he heard Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say about the words of Allah, “Through the signs and with the star people do find their way.” [16:16] “Star is the Messenger of Allah (s.a) and the signs are the Imams (a.s.)”
